title: Improving Consistency Models with Generator-Induced Flows

contributions.purpose: 澄清一致性训练(CT)与一致性蒸馏(CD)之间因单样本 Monte Carlo 估计误差导致的差异是否会在连续时间极限下消失
contributions.mechanism: 理论分析:证明在连续时间极限下 CT 与 CD 损失收敛到不同的逐点值,并给出该差异的闭式表达;该差异在损失值和梯度上都存在,仅在(渐近)二次损失这一特例下两极限恰好重合
contributions.evaluation: 定性/理论(Appendix A.1 证明);差异当速度场与其 Monte Carlo 近似之差趋零时消失,但标准估计所用 independent coupling (IC) 不满足此条件
contributions.domain: 生成模型 / 扩散与一致性模型 / 图像生成
contributions.source_quote: We prove that in the continuous time-limit consistency training and consistency distillation loss function converge to different pointwise values and we provide a closed-form expression of this discrepancy.

contributions.purpose: 在无法访问真实底层扩散模型的情况下,降低速度场单样本估计的方差以缩小 CT 与 CD 的差异
contributions.mechanism: 提出 generator-induced flows:用当前训练中的一致性模型自身作为真实 flow 的代理,从 IC 中间点预测端点,再与原噪声耦合形成 generator-induced coupling (GC),从而构造新的目标 flow
contributions.evaluation: 定性:GC 具有利于训练一致性模型的性质(速度场与估计偏差更小、传输代价更低,Figure 1)
contributions.domain: 生成模型 / 一致性模型
contributions.source_quote: We propose a novel type of flows that we denote generator-induced flows. It relies on generator-induced coupling (GC) that can be used to train a consistency model.

contributions.purpose: 论证 GC 相较标准 IC 一致性训练和专用 OT 一致性模型的优势
contributions.mechanism: 理论 + 实证分析:证明 GC 到 CD 的差异比 IC-CT 更小,并证明 GC 的数据-噪声传输代价随时间衰减更快(Theorem 2,假设理想一致性模型)
contributions.evaluation: 理论(Appendix A.2/A.3)+ CIFAR-10 等图像数据集实证;GC 减少 data-noise transport cost
contributions.domain: 生成模型 / 最优传输 / 一致性模型
contributions.source_quote: We provide theoretical and empirical insights into the advantages of GC,notably on image datasets. We show that generator-induced flows have smaller discrepancy to consistency distillation than IC consistency training, and that they reduce data-noise transport costs.

contributions.purpose: 把 generator-induced flow 变为可实际训练一致性模型的算法,解决纯 GC 训练的分布偏移/发散问题
contributions.mechanism: 混合策略 iCT-GC(μ):每步以概率 μ 采 GC 对、其余采标准 IC(μ=0 即纯 IC,μ=1 即纯 GC),缓解 GC 模型在 IC 轨迹上弱导致的分布偏移
contributions.evaluation: 四数据集 FID(iCT-IC/iCT-OT/iCT-GC μ=0.5):CIFAR-10 7.42/6.75/5.95;ImageNet32 14.89/14.13/13.99;CelebA64 15.82/13.63/11.74;LSUN Church64 10.58/9.71/9.88;μ=0.5~0.7 为收敛速度与最终 FID 的甜点;收敛更快
contributions.domain: 生成模型 / 图像生成
contributions.source_quote: We derive practical ways to train consistency models with generator-induced flows in image generation benchmarks. Our approach based on a mixing strategy leads to faster convergence and improves the performance compared to the base model and OT-based approaches.

self_declared_provenance.quote: One possible solution to this problem from the consistency and flow matching literatures (Pooladian et al., 2023; Dou et al., 2024) is to resort to optimal transport (OT) to learn on a deterministic coupling.However, due to the prohibitive cubic complexity of OT solvers ... such methods need to be applied at the minibatch level. This incurs an OT approximation error
Our experiments are based on the improved training techniques for consistency models from Song and Dhariwal (2024), denoted iCT-IC.

Our method does not rely on an iterative procedure but rather on a mixing procedlure during a single training, alleviating error accumulation. While not fully solving the alignment issue either, we will show that our method present reduced transport costs and better alignment than dedicated OT-based methods.

notes: ICLR 2025 reject。多处负结果/trade-off/comparable,项目重点信号密集:(1)纯 GC 训练(μ=1)收敛快但早期饱和/发散,达不到 base iCT-IC 性能,根因是 IC/GC 分布偏移(Finding,Fig 4)——正是这条负发现催生了混合策略。(2)Finding 4 明说混合'在多数情况下'优于 batch-OT,非全部:LSUN Church(64×64)上 iCT-OT FID 9.71 反而略优于 iCT-GC 9.88(comparable/略负)。(3)预训练端点预测器可解发散但需先训一个标准一致性模型、性能依赖该预测器,作者自评'not ideal'。(4)每训练步需额外一次无梯度前向,wall-clock 开销约比 iCT-IC 多 20%,但 iso-time 下仍优于 iCT-IC。(5)作者声明其 iCT-IC 复现因模型/batch 更小,未达 Song & Dhariwal 2024 原报告水平。
